thread:
emma-support: FYI customer @AcmeApps hitting 403 and SDK prints 'Invalid API key' when calling embeddings after they switched to a paid plan this morning. customer request_id=req_01A2B3, tenant=acct-12345

jordan-cs: Can you paste the raw response they see? sometimes billing gates get mistaken for auth errors in the SDK.

emma-support: here's the snippet they pasted: ```json
{
  "error": "Invalid API key",
  "code": 403,
  "message": "entitlement check failed",
  "request_id": "req_01A2B3"
}
``` They say curl + our JS SDK both fail.

liam-engineer: thx. can you also paste the request headers they used (sanitized)? specifically Authorization header and any x-tenant headers. and did they rotate keys?

emma-support: they used: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXXXX" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-Tenant-ID: acct-12345" \\n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
``` key is their active live key per billing panel, not rotated.

liam-engineer: curious — billing service shows acct-12345 upgraded to 'growth-plus' SKU at 2026-03-15 09:03 UTC?

billing-bot: ACCOUNT_UPDATE acct-12345 SKU=growth-plus effective=2026-03-15T09:03:21Z change_id=chg_9f2

liam-engineer: ok. this smells like entitlement gating not mapping the new SKU to embeddings entitlement. sometimes the platform returns 403 but SDK surfaces as 'Invalid API key'. we should repro locally. can someone create a repro tenant or grant me test access to acct-12345?

alex-plat: I can't give access to prod tenant, but I created a repro: tenant acct-repro-emb-17106 with SKU=growth-plus and a test key. I can share the key privately. steps to repro I ran: 1) POST to /v1/embeddings with that tenant header and key 2) observe 403 body includes "entitlement check failed" 3) trace id shows routing to entitlement-service v2.5.

liam-engineer: got it. can you paste the entitlement-service debug log line that corresponds? need to see why mapping failed.

alex-plat: log: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] TRACE req=req_repro_42 tenant=acct-repro-emb-17106 sku=growth-plus entitlement_lookup=embeddings -> result=DENIED reason=sku_not_mapped cache_hit=false
```

liam-engineer: perfect. cause seems to be an incomplete mapping for growth-plus -> embeddings in the billing->entitlement sync table (new SKU introduced last quarter). the cache being cold explains cache_hit=false. currently our SDK conflates 403 with auth errors so user sees 'Invalid API key'. we need two things: 1) immediate workaround for the customer, 2) fix mapping and prevent SDK from showing misleading message.

jordan-cs: immediate workaround: we can flip the tenant's entitlement override to allow embeddings until mapping is fixed. opsbot can you apply a temporary override for acct-12345? include audit note.

opsbot: RUNNING: apply_entitlement_override tenant=acct-12345 feature=embeddings allow=true ttl=24h reason="support: unblock customer while billing mapping patched" requested_by=emma-support

opsbot: SUCCESS: override applied id=ovr_88b audit_note="support run - unblock embeddings for acct-12345"

emma-support: told customer to retry — they confirmed success and embeddings now work. customer grateful but asked for permanent fix and why SDK message was misleading.

liam-engineer: next steps: (A) update billing->entitlement mapping to include growth-plus -> embeddings (PR queued: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/PR/472), (B) add guard in SDK to surface explicit 403 entitlements message when body contains "entitlement" or "sku_not_mapped", (C) add healthcheck/monitoring alert when cache misses spike for entitlement lookups. I'll own A and B. Jordan, can you own C with SRE?

jordan-cs: yes, will spin up an alert: entitlement-cache-miss-rate > 5% for 5m -> p1 pager.

alex-plat: added note to PR to also backfill mapping history and add unit tests for new SKU.

emma-support: summary for ticket INC-2026-0345: customer acct-12345 blocked by entitlement SKU mapping after plan upgrade; temporary override applied; embeddings restored; engineering PR in flight to add permanent mapping + SDK change to clearer error; SRE alert created. closing loop with customer once PR deployed.

liam-engineer: ETA for PR merge and deploy? I can get it through today if no regression.

alex-plat: aiming EOD deploy to canary, full rollout tomorrow morning. will post rollback plan in PR.

emma-support: thanks team. I'll follow up with customer and attach steps + request id. :white_check_mark:
